title: Case shelled to the fillet radius

description.en: A moulded case: outside 70 x 50 x 25 mm (corner at the origin, along +X, +Y, +Z), the top edges and the four upright corners rounded with a 2 mm radius, the bottom edges sharp, hollowed to a 2 mm wall, open at the bottom. The wall equals the radius, so the inside corners come out sharp. Drive it by the variables length, width, height, radius and wall; the expectations hold for any wall up to the radius.
description.nl: Een gegoten behuizing: buitenmaat 70 x 50 x 25 mm (hoek in de oorsprong, langs +X, +Y, +Z), de randen van de bovenkant en de vier staande hoeken afgerond met een straal van 2 mm, de onderranden scherp, uitgehold tot een wand van 2 mm, open aan de onderkant. De wand is even dik als de straal, dus de binnenhoeken worden scherp. Stuur hem met de variabelen length, width, height, radius en wall; de verwachtingen gelden voor elke wand tot aan de straal.

variables.name: radius
variables.meaning: outside radius of the rounded edges

derivation: The same closed form as rounded-cover: the hollow is the outside offset inward by the wall, with radius r - t, here 0: a plain box (L - 2t) x (W - 2t) x (H - t) open at the bottom, whose formulas are the rounded ones with r = 0.

This is the classic enclosure (round the edges, then a wall as thick as the radius). The shell builds it since 2026-10-22: rounds whose radius the wall reaches are collapsed first and the sharp body is hollowed (roadmap M9). The closed form holds for any wall t >= r, since (r - t) appears unclamped.

solution.name: flat walls as thick as wall
